verdict.rationale: Greptile documents one clear bulk action: a Fix All button in the review summary that sends every review issue to a coding agent at once. It also automatically reviews every PR, and `greptile onboard` enables repositories in a single setup run, but bulk operations across many PRs, repos or comments are not otherwise evidenced. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond a single PR's issues (e.g. bulk-resolve comments or bulk-configure repos across the org), API or CLI batch commands, independent or hands-on corroboration of Fix All.
